title: Picking and Placing in Order: A State Machine With a Check After Every Step That Can Fail

questions.question: Why is a pick a state machine and not a script?
options: Each step can fail and the next step depends on whether it did

questions.question: A hand closed on nothing has a gap:
questions.explanation: That is how a miss is seen.

questions.question: A hand that missed every time stopped in fault:
A part that fell on the way was noticed:
questions.explanation: The gap is watched while carrying.

questions.question: Why does every state have a time limit?
options: A move that never arrives would hold the machine for ever

questions.question: Does the machine know where the part is?
options: No: a target is a number that a planner turns into a motion
questions.explanation: It is a function from sensed to commanded.
